dependencyBumpExemption._comment: Narrow, fail-closed carve-out so Dependabot pin bumps (e.g. ruby/setup-ruby 1.321.0->1.324.0) satisfy the high-risk trace requirement via a standing trace instead of an impossible per-PR trace. Restricted to .github/workflows/**: dependabot.yml only watches the github-actions ecosystem here (no package manifest/lockfile in this repo to bump). trustedCommitAuthorLogin/trustedCommitCommitterLogin are checked per-commit alongside commit.verification (verified==true, reason=="valid"): dependabot[bot]/web-flow login match alone is not authenticated (an insider can spoof git author/committer email to match), so both the login pair AND GitHub's own signed verification are required. Any human author, unverified/mismatched-count commit, non-uses: workflow edit, or file outside allowedPathPatterns still requires a changed trace.
